hero.title: What customers tell you stays in the room
hero.lede: After the one-time model download, Crewline answers with the network cable out.

items.title: Customer messages
items.text: Read and answered by models on your PC. On the test day, none were sent to a cloud.

items.title: Orders and addresses
items.text: In a local database that you imported yourself.

items.title: Voices
items.text: Heard and spoken on your own hardware.

items.title: Photos
items.text: Scaled down and read by a vision model on your PC.

items.title: Your documents
items.text: Indexed on this machine, with nothing uploaded.

items.title: Telemetry
items.text: There isn't any. The app doesn't call home.

cable.title: Pull the cable out
cable.lede: You only need the internet to download the app and the models.

image.alt: A blue network cable, close up.

items.question: Do I still need to look after the data?
items.answer: Yes. It's your computer, so backups and access are yours to manage.

items.question: What about when it connects to my website?
items.answer: That part isn't built yet. Messages would have to travel from your site to your PC, and we'll say exactly how when it exists.
